info.name: Vimas - User (Buyer & Merchant)
info.description: Buyer and merchant-facing APIs for the Vimas e-commerce backend. Run "Register" (username + password, optionally referred_username) to create an account and auto-populate {{token}} and {{refresh_token}} — no email verification is required. Afterwards call "Update Profile" to add first/last name, email, address, country, and phone number. Use "Login (Username)" to sign back in, or "Refresh Token" once the access token expires.

request.description: type=reseller restricts results to bulk-purchasable products (bulk_available = 1). Omit (or any other value) to get the full catalog.

Response conditionally includes totalPoints (if the product's showTotalPoints is on) and pointsSharing — an array of { receiverType, pointsPercentage, points } for each active BUY_PRODUCT distribution rule — if showPointsSharing is on. type=reseller returns "Product not found" unless the product's bulk_available = 1.
Returns just id + packageQuantity + unitPrice per active package — enough to render a "buy N units" picker.
Full product_bulk_details row for the package the buyer picked from the list above, scoped to that product.
cart_type is optional and defaults to "consumer" when omitted. Allowed values: consumer, reseller.

request.description: Frontend polls this after Stripe redirects back with ?session_id=... to confirm payment status.
Lazily creates a zeroed balance row on first call if the buyer/merchant has none yet.

Full referral downline tree. Each node shows earnedForMe (points earned directly from that member's own purchases) and subtreeTotal (earnedForMe + everyone below them). Response also includes a totalDownlineEarnings grand total.
Wallet snapshot, current-month earned/redeemed points, and REFERRAL_LEVEL_1/REFERRAL_LEVEL_2 reward counts + totals for the logged-in user.
Omit rating (and set parentFeedbackId) to post a reply to another feedback/comment instead of a top-level review.
Soft-deletes (status becomes 'deleted') so replies/likes from other users are preserved.
